notes: Every game now fills the screen with its controls under your thumb, boards fit it and sit in the middle rather than against the top, and picross and scrabble zoom by pinching and settle on whole squares. The line above a board is no longer hidden under the header, the crossword keeps its clue and its keyboard in place while you read the clue list, and the break can no longer be ended by accident from inside a game. The countdown has a face of its own that scales with the dial, and the spiders walk the roof and the floor, keep to the wall, move their legs while they do, and pass behind the clock instead of over it.
